texts: On day 365 of Year 2, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
The Council accepted Old Vesh's bright-station proposal.
The Council issued extra mire-essence rations to three stations of the Middle Row in order to draw crowds of nightmoths.
The Council issued the extra rations in order to keep sky-cats hunting on the Cliff Path.

sentences: On day 365 of Year 2, the moon was full.
The Council convened at the Watch.
The Council accepted Old Vesh's bright-station proposal.
The Council issued extra mire-essence rations to three stations of the Middle Row in order to draw crowds of nightmoths.
The Council issued the extra rations in order to keep sky-cats hunting on the Cliff Path.

q1_issues.issue: The plural "crowds of nightmoths" is collapsed into a single crowd individual (Member sk_crowd_1 crowd), so the stated plurality of crowds is lost.

bright_station is decomposed a second level down (station + bright) although it is never the kind of any referent and its modifier genus is correctly suppressed, leaving orphaned atoms beyond the "decompose once, then stop" licence.

q2_gaps: an ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 365 of Year 2") — the Time term inventory supplies only (Day <n>) for a calendar day-of-month, so a day-of-year reading is indistinguishable from a day-of-month one

a maintenance verb with a participial eventive complement ("keep sky-cats hunting") — the resultative/maintenance rule covers only an adjectival state result (kept the gate shut) with its flat copular half, and gives no shape for an activity complement

a cardinal partitive whose superset is a named individual rather than a "the Ns" group ("three stations of the Middle Row") — the partitive rule presupposes a GroupOf superset, so no licensed link exists between the counted group and the named whole
review.notes: Strong handling of the two purpose infinitives on one reused sk_issue_1 event, of Old Vesh's proposal as an event-noun subject role rather than Possession, and of the Council/Watch capitalized-common-noun default. The PartOf link from the station group to middle_row is an improvisation but built from licensed heads.

issues.reason: The observation stands — "crowds" is plural and the parse records one crowd, so the plurality is unrecoverable — but the defect charge does not: (Member sk_crowd_1 crowd) and (GroupOf sk_crowd_1 nightmoth) are the instruction set's own "a flock of birds" pattern, every atom is true and well-typed, and nothing over-asserts, while a set whose members are themselves groups has no licensed carrier (GroupOf takes a member kind), so this is gap territory.

*Compound concepts* licenses exactly one decomposition level and never exposes a noun modifier, so bright_station_proposal's whole licensed unpacking is (Inheritance bright_station_proposal proposal); (Inheritance bright_station station) and (Inheritance bright_station bright) are unlicensed atoms about a kind no referent in the passage bears, and the section's own "determined, not optional" bar ("an optional atom makes two faithful parses differ") is what they break.

gaps_confirmed: an ordinal day-of-year in a non-Gregorian calendar ("day 365 of Year 2"): the Time term inventory supplies only (Day <n>) for day-of-month, so a day-of-year reading is indistinguishable from it

a maintenance verb with a participial eventive complement ("keep sky-cats hunting"): the maintenance/resultative rule specifies only an adjectival state result with its flat copular half, and gives no shape for an activity complement

a cardinal partitive whose superset is a named individual rather than a "the Ns" group ("three stations of the Middle Row"): the partitive rule presupposes a GroupOf superset, so the link from the counted group to the named whole is unlicensed
new_gaps: a plural collective-of NP ("crowds of nightmoths"): GroupOf's second slot is a member KIND and the flock pattern is singular, so a plural set of groups has no licensed form and the plural marking cannot be recorded at all — a licensed form would need to carry both the number of crowds and each crowd's member kind
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form for "Old Vesh's bright-station proposal" is (Member sk_proposal_1 bright_station_proposal) + (Agent sk_proposal_1 old_vesh) + (Inheritance bright_station_proposal proposal) and nothing else — no atoms on the un-exposed noun modifier bright_station.
adjudication.notes: The same unlicensed second-level decomposition recurs at line 31, (Inheritance mire_essence essence) beside the correct (Inheritance mire_essence_ration ration), which the reviewer did not flag — the fix is systematic, not one-off. The improvised (Result sk_keep_1 sk_hunt_1) + (Still sk_hunt_1) for "keep sky-cats hunting" is acceptable in gap territory: it is the maintenance-verb shape with a true, well-typed, tenseless activity witness standing in for the adjectival state.
